vector_memory.semantic_summary: This abstract class defines the contract for bridging the application's core simulation logic with any external physics engine implementation. It serves as a crucial service layer, abstracting away specific physics library details to provide a standardized interface for managing entities, forces, and physical states. Its methods cover lifecycle management, entity registration, state synchronization, and performing physics queries like raycasting.
